answer_1.quote: Following the "text-to-text" approach of T5 , we cast all tasks as text generation.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate text outputs for tasks reformulated as conditional generation, such as classification labels, answers to questions, or paraphrases.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate each GLUE and SuperGLUE dataset using the metric specified in the benchmark. We reuse the evaluation code from the publicly available T5 open-source release to compute metrics.
